translation: Not poisonous. Its chief actions are to dispel edema, dropsy-distension (臚脹), glomus fullness (痞滿), cold-heat, pain throughout the whole body, and (treat) difficult lactation and throat impediment with swelling, and stop tears and nasal discharge. One name is 重 [瓣], one name 重邁, one name 摩羅, one name 中逢花, one name 強瞿.
